description:
LocalGateKeys keeps your passwords in an encrypted vault on your Mac. There's no account to create and no server of ours holding your passwords: your vault is encrypted on this Mac and unlocked with your master password or Touch ID.

FILL IN SECONDS
• AutoFill your logins and one-time codes in Safari and other apps
• Use LocalGateKeys for passkeys
• Safari offers to save a new login after you sign in

MADE FOR THE MAC
• Search and copy from the menu bar without opening the window
• Press Control-Option-K in any app to find what you need
• ⌘K searches items, actions and settings; keyboard shortcuts for everything else
• Touch ID, auto-lock when you step away, and open at login if you want

TWO-FACTOR CODES BUILT IN
• One-time codes right next to the login they belong to
• Add a website's 2FA QR code from a screenshot, or bring codes over from your authenticator app

STAY ON TOP OF YOUR SECURITY
• A Security centre with a score: weak and reused passwords, and logins that could use two-factor codes
• Check your passwords against known breaches, only when you choose; just a short hash prefix is sent
• Password history for every login

BACKUPS YOU CONTROL
• Full encrypted backups that also restore in LocalGateKeys for Windows
• Scheduled backups to a folder you choose, with an optional mirror in your cloud folder
• A 24-word recovery phrase in case you forget your master password

MORE THAN PASSWORDS
• Cards, notes, identities, bank accounts, Wi-Fi, licences, API keys, SSH keys, subscriptions, warranties and more
• Attach documents, stored encrypted in your vault
• Share one item securely: the other person opens it once, with a six-word code
• Import from Apple Passwords, Safari, Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass and authenticator apps
• Recently deleted keeps items for 30 days

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• No analytics, no tracking, no ads
• A clipboard that clears itself, and copies that clipboard managers are told not to keep
• Optional encrypted sync with LocalGateKeys on your iPhone and your Windows PC, over your own Wi-Fi or through your own cloud folder
• One Pro purchase unlocks LocalGateKeys on your iPhone and Mac. Buying Pro sends only the App Store receipt to our licence server, so your purchase also unlocks LocalGateKeys for Windows. It is not linked to you.
promotionalText: LocalGateKeys is now on the Mac: your encrypted vault, 2FA codes, Touch ID and quick access from the menu bar. No account, no cloud of ours.
